author: Arcotic0
quote: Dont listen to the review bombs about this game. People are still mad that the main character is a woman and that there are predominantly more people of color being shown in this game compared to its last title. This game is definitely a contender for GOTY for the things it gets right graphically, story wise, and mechanic wise. I have been thoroughly enjoying this title and i encourage anyone whose into post apologize worlds and sci fi to take a shot at the horizon series
